name: Open Charge Map
tagline: Crowdsourced global EV charging location database with free API access.
description: Open Charge Map provides a free API for querying its global registry of electric-vehicle charging locations. Developers can search by location, filter by connector type and operator/network, and retrieve detailed site, equipment, access, and status data. A free API key is required. No numerical quota is published; qualitative fair-use rules apply, and excessive or indiscriminate callers may be blocked.

auth.details: API key via X-API-Key header or key query parameter; free self-serve registration required

pricing.free_tier_limits: No published numeric quota. Free basic access is subject to fair use: throttle requests, avoid duplicate or excessive queries, and self-host or import the data for high-volume use. Administrators may block abusive callers.

use_cases: find EV chargers near a lat/lng
list charging stations by country or region
filter chargers by connector type or power
check operator/network for a charging site
get detailed POI data for a known station ID
